name: m365_get_content
title: Get Content
description: Get the content of an item rather than its details: save a OneDrive file or an email attachment to a local file (mode='download'), get a temporary download link for a OneDrive file (mode='download_url'), or export a contact as a vCard (mode='vcard'). Writes to the local disk only inside the allowed folders. Use m365_get for item details.

account_id.description: Account ID or email address. Omit when only one account is signed in.

id.description: OneDrive item ID, email ID or contact ID.

mode.description: download: drive_item file or email attachment to save_path. download_url: drive_item file only. vcard: contact only.

attachment_id.description: email + download only: attachment ID from m365_get(resource='email').

save_path.description: Local file path inside the server's allowed folders. Hidden and secret files are refused.

overwrite.description: Replace save_path if it already exists.

outputSchema.description: Content result; fields that do not apply to the mode are null. download_url is a short-lived pre-authenticated link: treat it as a secret.

summary.description: One-line human summary. The tool's text content is this result serialized as JSON (summary included), so a client that ignores structuredContent still sees every field.

graph_calls: drive_item download: GET /me/drive/items/{id} then stream @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl to save_path (≤ MCP_FILE_DOWNLOAD_MAX_MB)
contact vcard: GET /me/contacts/{id}, rendered as vCard 3.0

validation_rules.rule: mode must suit the resource (download: drive_item or email; download_url: drive_item; vcard: contact).
validation_rules.error: Invalid mode 'vcard': not valid for resource 'drive_item'. Expected: download or download_url

validation_rules.rule: save_path is required for download and must be inside the allowed roots and not deny-listed.
validation_rules.error: Invalid save_path: outside allowed folders. Expected: a path under the working directory, temp directory or MCP_FILE_ALLOWED_ROOTS

validation_rules.rule: attachment_id is required for email download.
Existing files are not replaced unless overwrite=true.
validation_rules.error: Invalid save_path: file exists. Expected: overwrite=true or another path
Invalid id: item is a folder. Expected: a file
